title: Requests for More Physical Controls
summary: Feedback centers on customers wanting more dedicated physical buttons and knobs, especially for climate, radio, and quick-access functions, with only a few fragments expressing clearly negative dissatisfaction.

negative.summary: Negative feedback explicitly criticizes the lack of physical controls, especially for climate adjustments, and describes touchscreen-based operation as distracting or frustrating.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mainly states a preference for restoring physical buttons or knobs for climate, radio presets, safety menu access, trunk closing, and other commonly used functions without clearly stating overall satisfaction.

limitations: Most fragments are labeled undetermined, so the sample contains many stated preferences without clear sentiment intensity.
The topic includes several different control areas, such as climate, radio, safety menus, and key fob functions, so it is not fully focused on a single feature.
Examples are limited to the supplied fragments, and no broader frequency or representativeness should be inferred from them.
